hardware: single node with four NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB GPUs
baselines: measured oracle sweep C=1..16 for predictor accuracy

settings.name: routing matrix
settings.description: 3 models × uniform/p50/p90 × 5 lengths = 45 configurations per TP/EP configuration

settings.name: measurement
settings.description: 20 warmups; operator/layer 60 ABBA-interleaved samples; complete-model/multi-backend 20 samples; median maximum-rank latency; 20,000 block-stratified bootstrap replicates for 95% CI

data.correctness: COMETと提案法は同一input、weight、router assignment、GEMM tile、通信量を使い、4-rank allcloseとcomplete-model出力一致を確認。Hugging Face参照に対して全モデルでlast-token top-1を保持し、Qwen/DeepSeek-V2-Liteはelementwise allcloseも通過。
data.methodology: predictor accuracyはTP=4/EP=1のreal-p90 15 workloadでC=1..16を実測sweepしたoracleと比較。性能はtarget operator、complete post-router MoE layer、complete-model prefillの3境界で評価。
data.scope: single-node A100/NVLinkのprefill中心。complete-model評価はonline-serving全体やdecode throughputを表さない。
